definition.label: Joint local-context Kumo and29-input spectral correction
definition.formula: Use exact cached V178 raw Kumo=.85*global+.15*local; refit29-input V167 correction with L2.003 and inference shrink.5; final=.75*sigmoid(logit(pK178)+.5*X29*beta)+.25*original_spline77
definition.rationale: V185 combines final scores after independent heads; directly test whether spectral and context signals survive joint training. V185 public .56699 below V25 .56822 warns that an OOF-only gain is insufficient. Expect higher capacity risk; compare29-input head gap to V25.

definition.label: Joint context/spectral correction with selective group shrinkage
definition.formula: Same raw V178 Kumo and29 inputs asV191; meanBCE+.003/2*sum(base_beta^2)+.01/2*sum(spectral_beta^2), intercept unpenalized; inference shrink.5; original75:25 spline fusion
definition.rationale: V167 head train-validation KS gap .016101 vsV25 .011108. Test joint information with stronger shrinkage specifically on all11 spectral inputs, including unstable dominant-cycle argmax; keeps input set matched to V191.

definition.label: V185 plus bounded inner-OOF partial-pooling calibration residual
definition.formula: z=logit(pV185); d=.5*clip(logit(pV189)-logit(pV25),-.1,.1); p=sigmoid(z+d); per-fold test fusion then mean5fold
definition.rationale: V189 low-dimensional inner-OOF employment/history calibration yielded KS .530638, deltaAUC -0.0000041 vsV25; no generalization claim. Test bounded partial-pooling effect onV185; reject leaderboard recommendation if AUC or stability deteriorates. No fitted score weights.

definition.label: Inner-crossfitted spectral/local evidence combination
definition.formula: For each outer fold,3 inner splits of6k train base18/global, spectral29/global, local18/V178 heads on4k and predict held2k. Fit w_s,w_l in[0,1.5] by BCE(z_base+w_s*(z_s-z_base)+w_l*(z_l-z_base))+.02/2*((w_s-1)^2+(w_l-1)^2). Apply weights to full6k corrected-Kumo heads; final=.75*sigmoid(eta)+.25*original_spline77
definition.rationale: V185 fixed logit fusion increases pooledKS but only3/5folds and mixed public outcome. Learn complementarity using strictly inner-OOF predictions, never using in-sample original spline or outer labels for mixing weights. Difference from V185 includes fusion before original spline and training-only weight fit.

definition.label: Coverage safeguard for V185 spectral correction
definition.formula: p=pV178 when aux_allocation_count<=0 or missing; otherwise pV185; per-fold test fusion then mean5fold
definition.rationale: V185 no-allocation segment deltaKS -.003403 vsV25, while1:3 observations +.006123 and over3 +.000197; V178 no-allocation deltaKS -.000260. Fixed availability gate tests a mechanism suggested by prior outer errors; it is post-selection and not independent confirmation. Distinct from V172 fallback toV25 on a different spectral-context backbone.
